outcome.answer: Saahil Mathur and coauthors study RAG for AI policy question answering in “Retrieval Improvements Do Not Guarantee Better Answers: A Study of RAG for AI Policy QA” [1]. Using a corpus of AI policy documents, they find that domain-specific fine-tuning improves retrieval metrics but does not consistently improve end-to-end QA; stronger retrieval can even produce more confident hallucinations when relevant documents are missing [1].
